mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, no significant negative excess returns in similar tightening events (Granger causality rejected, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 jobs (PAYEMS) coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as stronger labor demand boosts corporate optimism.
failure_condition: In 10 similar monthly events with PAYEMS > 200,000, less than 30% produced positive 20-day forward returns (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in home sales (HOUST) of more than 10% predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as weak housing demand reduces corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by >10% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: During three comparable housing contractions, the 60-day forward returns were not statistically worse than average (Mann-Whitney U, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.0 while CPIAUCSL is flat suggests resilient supply capacity, leading to a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates sustained output.
failure_condition: In 10 similar supply-resilience events, the 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in UNRATE below 6% increases the real discount rate, producing a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return when FEDFUNDS remains unchanged.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 6% for 3 consecutive months and FEDFUNDS unchanged
failure_condition: Across 5 such episodes, no significant negative excess returns (Granger causality rejected, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS reading above 550,000 coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as strong retail demand signals consumer confidence.
failure_condition: In 4 similar high-RSAFS events, 60-day forward returns are not statistically superior (binomial test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in GDPC1 exceeding 5% indicates a sharp contraction in business fixed investment, which predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases by >5% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: During 3 analogous investment contractions, the 20-day forward returns were not worse than average (Mann-Whitney U, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in a month while FEDFUNDS is steady, the market anticipates higher inflation and discount rates, producing a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% and FEDFUNDS unchanged
failure_condition: In 7 similar inflation surprises, the 5-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test, p > 0.05).
